methods.name: design
methods.title: Design the interface
methods.says: design the look of the app with its owner, from a mood board and an icon set to the screens, each step closed when the owner chooses among live variants (method/design.md)

steps.name: mood-board
steps.title: Mood board
steps.exit: The owner names one variant, or a combination, as the app's direction; its tokens are in tokens/, the checks pass and the decision is recorded.

steps.name: palette
steps.title: Palette
steps.exit: The owner accepts one palette in light and dark; every contrast pair passes; the colour tokens are in tokens/ and the decision is recorded.

steps.name: typography
steps.title: Typography
steps.exit: The owner accepts one type system; nothing clips at 200% zoom or 320 px width; typography.tokens.json is written and the decision is recorded.

steps.name: icons
steps.title: Icons
steps.exit: The owner chooses one of the predefined icon sets; check.icons in stance-ui.json names it, its Svelte package is installed, the icons check passes and the decision is recorded.

steps.name: widget-shapes
steps.title: Widget shapes
steps.exit: The owner accepts one set of radius, spacing, shadow and motion; targets are at least 24 px and focus rings 3:1; the tokens are final and the decision is recorded.

steps.name: screens
steps.title: Screens
steps.exit: The owner accepts every listed screen; each is in check.pages and deno task check passes; the decisions are recorded.
